digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: CI workflows must apply filter: blob:none to all tickets-branch fetch paths in reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml, and gerrit-verify.yaml to reduce transfer size and time
Standalone checkout must declare REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 and reject unfiltered all-history packs exceeding this limit; blobless packs must pass
Gerrit verify-identity must declare REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 and reject unfiltered all-history packs exceeding this limit after materialization; blobless materialized packs must pass

Real-Git protocol tests must verify filter capability advertisement and blob:none request negotiation via packet traces for named-origin inheritance, depth-1 direct URL, and full-history direct URL fetches
Production guards must snapshot exact git count-objects -v before and after materialization to ensure identity scanning adds no promisor objects
Blobless tickets must successfully reconverge independent local/remote changes with the ours driver, retain expected events, and push the merge
